annotations.description: Playing Mountain instead of Inspiring Vantage on turn 1 is suboptimal. Inspiring Vantage enters untapped when you control two or fewer other lands, so playing it on turn 1 guarantees it enters untapped. Later, if you play it as your third or later land, it might enter tapped. Mountain always enters untapped regardless of when you play it. By playing Mountain now, you risk having Inspiring Vantage enter tapped later. Additionally, with Hired Claw (a red 1-drop) in hand, either land would let you cast it, so there's no downside to playing Inspiring Vantage first — it produces red mana and preserves flexibility for future turns.

annotations.betterLine: Cast Burst Lightning targeting the opponent for 2 damage, using the untapped Sunbillow Verge. While prowess wouldn't matter post-combat, 2 damage to face with otherwise unused mana is still value in an aggressive deck.

annotations.description: Emberheart Challenger is about to die to Requiting Hex. By casting Full Bore targeting Emberheart Challenger in response, they could trigger Valiant (exile top card, play it this turn) for free card advantage, since Full Bore loses most of its value once the creature dies anyway. The Valiant trigger would resolve before the Hex destroys the creature.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any spells in response to Requiting Hex, letting Emberheart Challenger die without triggering Valiant.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Full Bore targeting Emberheart Challenger to trigger Valiant, gaining a free card from the top of the library before the creature is destroyed.

annotations.description: Nova Hellkite is attacking unblocked into an opponent at 10 life with Full Bore in hand and one untapped red source. Casting Full Bore would deal 7 instead of 4, putting the opponent to 3 life where Burst Lightning would be lethal next turn. Instead, they dealt only 4, leaving the opponent at 6.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any spells during combat, dealing only 4 damage with Nova Hellkite.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Full Bore on Nova Hellkite (using Sacred Foundry) to make it 7/7, dealing 7 damage and putting the opponent to 3 life — within Burst Lightning range for lethal next turn.

annotations.description: With Sacred Foundry untapped, Gem3F Hype could have cast Full Bore on Nova Hellkite during combat to deal 7 damage instead of 4, putting the opponent to 3 life. At 3 life, Burst Lightning next turn would be lethal. Instead, the opponent stays at 6 life, requiring much more work to close out the game.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any spells during combat, dealing only 4 damage with Nova Hellkite.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Full Bore targeting Nova Hellkite to give it +3/+2, dealing 7 damage total and putting the opponent to 3 life, setting up lethal with Burst Lightning next turn.

annotations.description: Gem3F Hype has Burst Lightning in hand and the opponent is at 6 life. Nova Hellkite is tapped (just attacked) and will be exiled at end step since it was cast for its warp cost. With Sacred Foundry untapped, they have exactly 1 mana available to cast Burst Lightning for 2 damage to the opponent's face, bringing them to 4 life. While that alone isn't lethal, the critical issue is that Nova Hellkite is about to be exiled anyway, so there's no reason not to use the available mana. However, looking more carefully: Sacred Foundry is the only untapped land (1 mana). Burst Lightning costs {R} and deals 2 damage. The opponent is at 6 life. 2 damage brings them to 4. This isn't lethal, but it's free damage with no downside since there's nothing else productive to do with 1 mana and the Hellkite is leaving anyway. Declining to cast Burst Lightning here wastes an opportunity to deal 2 damage for free when the opponent is at 6 life - every point matters at this stage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed without casting any spells, wasting 1 available mana and declining to deal 2 free damage to an opponent at 6 life.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Burst Lightning targeting GPT52 ESPN for 2 damage, reducing them to 4 life. With Nova Hellkite being exiled at end step regardless, there's no reason to hold mana open, and getting the opponent to 4 makes future burn/attacks more likely to be lethal.

annotations.description: Gem3F Hype has Burst Lightning in hand and the opponent is at 6 life. Nova Hellkite (4/5) is on the battlefield and attacked this turn (it's tapped). At end of turn, Burst Lightning deals 2 damage, bringing the opponent to 4 life. Next turn, Nova Hellkite attacks for 4, which is exactly lethal. However, more importantly, Gem3F Hype could also cast Full Bore on Nova Hellkite (making it 7/7) but it's already tapped so that doesn't help right now. The key issue is that Burst Lightning to face right now (2 damage, opponent goes to 4) sets up lethal next turn with the 4-power Nova Hellkite. But the opponent has untapped lands (Multiversal Passage and Restless Reef) and cards in hand that could include removal. Casting Burst Lightning now at end of turn to put the opponent to 4 is strictly better than not casting it - it costs only 1 mana and there's no reason to hold it. The opponent is at 6 life and every point of damage matters. By declining to cast Burst Lightning at end of turn, Gem3F Hype is missing guaranteed damage that could set up lethal or force the opponent into a worse position.
annotations.actionTaken: Declined to cast any instants at end of turn, passing with Burst Lightning and Full Bore in hand.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Burst Lightning targeting GPT52 ESPN (the opponent) for 2 damage, putting them to 4 life. This sets up lethal next turn with Nova Hellkite's 4 power attack, and even if the opponent has removal, the 2 damage is already locked in.

annotations.description: Gem3F Hype missed lethal. Nova Hellkite (4 power) attacking + Burst Lightning (2 damage) to face = exactly 6 damage, which is the opponent's life total. By passing priority, they gave the opponent the chance to activate Restless Reef as a 4/4 deathtouch blocker, potentially killing Nova Hellkite and preventing the 4 combat damage.
annotations.actionTaken: Passed priority without casting Burst Lightning, giving the opponent a window to activate Restless Reef as a 4/4 deathtouch potential blocker.
annotations.betterLine: Cast Burst Lightning targeting GPT52 ESPN for 2 damage during combat. Whether or not Nova Hellkite is blocked, 4 + 2 = 6 = opponent's life total for guaranteed lethal.
